item.title: SCVTV’s Community Corner Season 6 Rewind, Episode 1
item.description: In this Community Corner mini episode, student guest hosts Kayleigh Behar from Hart High School and Jayne Gilchrist from Saugus High School rewind through Season 6, revisiting segments from 2025. The episode includes conversations on the Career and College Readiness Program, Bowman High School, Placerita Junior High’s Dual Immersion Program, and an update from the Castaic Union School District
